messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
Ni ai na ma kasa cin abinci sabida na sha wahala yau, ana kiran sallah na sha ruwa yakai lita 2😂

output.original_text: Ni ai na ma kasa cin abinci sabida na sha wahala yau, ana kiran sallah na sha ruwa yakai lita 2😂
output.joy: Na ji dadin wannan rana, duk da wahalhalun, sallah ta sa na sha ruwa lita 2! 😂
output.sadness: Yau na yi wahala sosai, har na kasa cin abinci, sallah ta tabbatar mana da sha ruwa hudu. 😞
output.fear: Wahalhalun yau sun bani tsoro, na kasa cin abinci, sallar ta zo kuma na sha ruwa lita 2. 😨
output.anger: Wahalhalun yau sun fi karfina, na kasa cin abinci, sallah ta sanya na sha ruwa lita 2, wannan ba daidai ba ne! 😡
output.surprise: Ban yi tsammani yau za ta kasance mai wahala haka ba, na kasa cin abinci, sannan na sha ruwa lita 2 kafin sallah! 😲
output.disgust: Yau wahalhalun sun ban haushi, na kasa cin abinci saboda sallar ta sa na sha ruwa lita 2, wannan yana da ban takaici! 🤢
